version_json.boundary: The isolated environment intentionally did not load the user's persisted channel.

help_observed.boundary: Help availability is not a protocol, task, permission, tool, child-task, recovery, or product acceptance result.

isolated_inspect.boundary: Inspect proved only clean isolated discovery shape and the builtin agent catalog; it did not execute a skill, MCP tool, model turn, or subagent.

materialized_bundled_guides.source: Exact user-guide bytes materialized by the installed 1.0.34 binary inside an isolated temporary home.
materialized_bundled_guides.boundary: Bundled documentation describes candidate behavior but is not evidence that InfiniShell invoked or completed that behavior.

static_candidate_counts.measurement: Exact non-overlapping byte-substring occurrences in the installed executable; shorter substrings may also occur inside longer strings.
static_candidate_counts.boundary: Counts and embedded method names are implementation-presence signals only. They do not establish request shape, authorization, native acknowledgement, execution, persistence, or compatibility.

native_parent_child_limit.documented_behavior: A root session may send to an owned subagent when active-agent messaging is enabled.
native_parent_child_limit.documented_limit: A child whose direct parent is the root session cannot send a native message back to that root session.
native_parent_child_limit.effect: The builtin native root-child topology cannot by itself satisfy arbitrary bidirectional parent-child message acknowledgement required by the product.

fail_closed_behavior: A second submit while a 1.0.34 turn is active is rejected rather than represented as a native queue acknowledgement.
Selected skills and local tools remain version-gated off.
Unverified 1.0.34 write approval requests are cancelled rather than broadened from read-only evidence.
Child tasks remain disabled because catalog registration or a tool lease is not a completed parent-child chain.
existing_adapter_gate.boundary: This is a static audit of the live dirty-tree adapter gate, not a compile, unit-test, GUI, native task, or same-commit cross-platform result.

existing_safe_receipt_boundaries.proved: Unauthenticated initialize shape for the same 1.0.34 binary digest.
existing_safe_receipt_boundaries.did_not_prove: Session creation, prompt, approval, cancel, tool, child task, recovery, or result collection.

existing_safe_receipt_boundaries.proved: Raw ACP read allow, read deny, cancel after real text, and cold root-session load/recall candidate flow.
existing_safe_receipt_boundaries.did_not_prove: Production runtime, full parity, skills, local tools, queued submit, steer, fixed write policy, or parent-child chain.

existing_safe_receipt_boundaries.proved: One GUI-visible exact native read approval and final marker on the recorded dirty candidate.
existing_safe_receipt_boundaries.did_not_prove: Independent GUI deny/cancel/resume, extended lifecycle, local tools, or child tasks.

capability_assessment.reliable_product_degradation: Keep 1.0.34 extended capabilities disabled and fail closed until exact authenticated native and product receipts exist.
